title: Change of rings for presheaves of modules is left adjoint to restriction
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, let $a:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings on $X$, let $\mathcal M$ be a presheaf of $\mathcal A$-modules and $\mathcal N$ a presheaf of $\mathcal B$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Write $\operatorname{Res}_a\mathcal N$ for the presheaf $\mathcal N$ regarded as a presheaf of $\mathcal A$-modules, $\mathcal A(U)$ acting on $\mathcal N(U)$ through $a_U:\mathcal A(U)\to\mathcal B(U)$. Let $\mathcal B\otimes_{p,\mathcal A}\mathcal M$ be the presheaf $U\mapsto\mathcal B(U)\otimes_{\mathcal A(U)}\mathcal M(U)$ (with $\mathcal B(U)$ an $\mathcal A(U)$-module through $a_U$), whose restriction map along $V\subseteq U$ sends $b\otimes m$ to $b|_V\otimes m|_V$, made a presheaf of $\mathcal B$-modules by $\mathcal B(U)$ acting on the left factor. Then sending a morphism of presheaves of $\mathcal B$-modules $v:\mathcal B\otimes_{p,\mathcal A}\mathcal M\to\mathcal N$ to the family $(m\mapsto v_U(1\otimes m))_U$ is a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal B}(\mathcal B\otimes_{p,\mathcal A}\mathcal M,\mathcal N)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(\mathcal M,\operatorname{Res}_a\mathcal N)$ onto the morphisms of presheaves of $\mathcal A$-modules, with inverse sending $w$ to the family $b\otimes m\mapsto b\,w_U(m)$; it is natural in $\mathcal M$ (a morphism $f:\mathcal M\to\mathcal M'$ acting on the left side by precomposition with $\mathrm{id}\otimes f$) and in $\mathcal N$.

proof.text: Construct tensorToRestrict and tensorFromRestrict using the sectionwise ModuleCat HomEquiv. Forward naturality is evaluation on 1 ⊗ m. For inverse naturality, use ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext; the required equality on 1 ⊗ m is exactly naturality of the input morphism. The sectionwise inverse laws give tensorHomEquiv; its inverse sends b ⊗ m to b • g(m).

proof.text: Postcomposition naturality of tensorHomEquiv is definitional. Apply Adjunction.leftAdjointOfEquiv to construct the tensor functor. Its map is the inverse Hom equivalence of f followed by the unit; the inverse formula and smul_tmul give b ⊗ m ↦ b ⊗ f(m). Choose identity sectionwise isomorphisms q. Forward formula and naturality in the source follow by evaluating on 1 ⊗ m; naturality in the target was already used to construct the functor.

split_report.summary: Split following Stacks 006R exactly: its proof is 'for a ring map A -> B the restriction functor and the change of ring functor are adjoint' (Algebra 05DQ, the existing Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-scalar-extension-hom, LinearMap.liftBaseChangeEquiv), applied open by open. Step 1 checks that the two presheaves of the statement are what the statement says (restriction maps of B (x)_{p,A} M from the universal property of the tensor product def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product, functoriality and B-semilinearity on generators; Res_a N semilinear), against def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification and def-weil-module-base-change. Step 2 is 05DQ at each U. Step 3 shows that the sectionwise bijections and their inverses carry morphisms of presheaves to morphisms of presheaves (compatibility with restrictions on generators b (x) m), so they assemble to the bijection with the stated formulas. Step 4 is naturality in M (id (x) f a morphism of presheaves, computed on 1 (x) m) and in N (the naturality clause of the leaf). No new node: every fact used is a Mathlib leaf or a definition node. No presheaf change-of-rings tensor node exists in the DAG (grep for 006R, otimes_{p, 'tensor product presheaf'; def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product is the sheaf tensor over one ring), so the construction stays inline in the statement as before. No slopmaster2 declaration (grep by id, 006R, adjointness-tensor-restrict; PresheafOfModules pullback/extendScalars files: only the abstract left adjoint pullbackOfCommRingCat in Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Presheaf/Pullback.lean, no sectionwise tensor identification).
